offer.text: Monsters spawn where the light fails. Ring the village edge with torches — a dozen should push the dark back past the wall.

accept.text: Good thinking. Light denies them the ground.

decline.text: Then we fight in the dark again tonight.

in_progress.text: How many torches up along the wall?

ready.text: The edge is bright as a hearth. They'll think twice now.

complete.text: A lit wall is a quiet wall. The watch sleeps easier for your work.
